test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Some students are standing in a queue. Only Radhika is standing between Sonia and Sujata. Divya is standing immediately ahead of Sonia. Exactly two girls are standing behind Sujata and only one girl is standing exactly ahead of Divya. How many students are standing in the queue?
solution:
Given: Some students are standing in a queue. 

Only Radhika is standing between Sonia and Sujata. 

Divya is standing immediately ahead of Sonia. 

Divya > Sonia > Radhika > Sujata

Exactly two girls are standing behind Sujata and only one girl is standing exactly ahead of Divya

______ > Divya > Sonia > Radhika > Sujata > _____ > ______

So,** '7'**** students are standing in a queue.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
